# pocketfft

`pocketfft_hdronly.h` is the C++ header-only version of pocketfft by
Martin Reinecke, the FFT library also used by numpy and scipy, distributed
under the BSD 3-clause license in `LICENSE.md`.

Copied unchanged from https://github.com/mreineck/pocketfft, branch `cpp`,
commit `4d865cba24359b05b37da4e75aee24498c3b78e7` (2026-10-18).
